quarter_end.description: End date of the current reported fiscal quarter, YYYY-MM-DD. Not the publication or dividend date.

quarter_revenue_usd_millions.description: Current quarter revenue in USD millions from the financial table. Use the three-month period and exact table amount, not rounded headline billions.

quarter_gaap_diluted_eps_usd.description: Current quarter GAAP diluted earnings per share in USD per share. Not basic, non-GAAP or year-to-date EPS.

quarter_non_gaap_diluted_eps_usd.description: Current quarter non-GAAP diluted earnings per share in USD per share as presented in this release.
